name: UniEdit-500K
description: UniEdit-500K is a large-scale, multi-category dataset for precise reference-guided image editing of arbitrary objects and ambiguous masks, containing over 500K image pairs across 8 major categories and 209 fine-grained subcategories. It supports training models to learn semantic relationships and distinctions across diverse object categories for robust image editing.
reputation: A large-scale image-editing dataset that is promising for training reference-guided editing models, but it is still too new to have established broad community adoption.
notes: Large-scale dataset addressing category diversity and mask ambiguity for arbitrary object image editing.
